test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 9 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

The lease of our house has __run down__.
solution:
The correct answer is run out.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate option that can substitute 'run down' is 'run out'.
 
• The phrase 'run down' means '**in bad condition'.**
 
• The phrase 'run out' means 'to be used up'.
 
• Hence, 'run out' is the most appropriate option to substitute 'run down'.

 

The correct sentence is: The lease of our house has run out.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Let's understand the meaning and usage of other options.

 
• Run into- collide with someone or something.

 
 
• ​Example: He ran into a lamp post.
 
 
 
• Run up to- a period immediately preceding an action or event.
 
 
• Example- There’s so much to do in the run-up to Christmas
